findings.message: reactive accessor "count" is read in a callback written in rendering function and passed to a function that is not proven to invoke it during the call; that function may invoke it then, later from a closure it returns or keeps, or never, so whether this read runs untracked in rendering function cannot be proven either way
findings.hint: Move the read into a tracking scope: JSX, a createMemo, or the compute function of createEffect(compute, apply). If a one-time snapshot is intended, wrap the read in untrack() to make that explicit. If this read executes untracked in dev, Solid warns STRICT_READ_UNTRACKED for it; this finding does not establish that it does, so confirm the read's actual execution and tracking status before relying on that warning.
